chunks: “A child is to be made to fast when he reaches nine years, according to the extent of what he can bear. So if he is able until noon or after it, he fasts until that time; then if hunger or thirst overcomes him, he breaks the fast.”

key_terms.عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا يُطِيقُهُ: according to the measure of what he is able to bear

ai.seo_question: At what age should a child begin practicing fasting according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on habituating a child to sawm (fasting) from the age of nine according to the child's capacity. It indicates gradual training in worship and allows breaking the fast when hunger or thirst becomes overwhelming.
